target.title: fix(fal): apply request policy to media generation requests
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users configuring FAL provider request policy for media generation would not have that policy applied to FAL image generation HTTP requests.

## Why This Change Was Made

FAL HTTP config now passes `models.providers.fal.request` into the existing provider HTTP request-policy resolver. This keeps FAL on the shared provider request seam and does not change model parameters, generation parsing, or generated image parsing. Explicit private-network opt-in is now honored from the configured request policy instead of being overridden by a hard-coded deny, while the default remains deny.

## User Impact

FAL media generation requests can now honor configured request headers, proxy/TLS transport settings, and explicit private-network request policy through the existing provider request policy mechanism.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/fal/image-generation-provider.test.ts` passed: 44 tests.
- `node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check extensions/fal/http-config.ts extensions/fal/image-generation-provider.test.ts` passed.
- `node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs extensions/fal/http-config.ts extensions/fal/image-generation-provider.test.ts` passed.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- Resolver proof: `resolveFalHttpRequestConfig` with configured `baseUrl`, `request.headers.X-Fal-Trace`, and `request.allowPrivateNetwork: true` returned `allowPrivateNetwork: true` plus the configured header and redacted Authorization header.
- Controlled real provider-path proof, using `buildFalImageGenerationProvider().generateImage()` against a local HTTP server through the normal Fal provider path:

```text
$ FAL_API_KEY=<redacted> node_modules/.bin/tsx --eval '<local Fal-compatible HTTP server + buildFalImageGenerationProvider().generateImage(...) harness>'
{
  "baseUrl": "http://127.0.0.1:<redacted>",
  "requests": [
    {
      "method": "POST",
      "url": "/fal-ai/flux/dev",
      "authorization": "<redacted>",
      "trace": "trace-harness",
      "contentType": "application/json",
      "body": "{\"prompt\":\"draw a local cat\",\"num_images\":1,\"output_format\":\"png\"}"
    },
    {
      "method": "GET",
      "url": "/files/generated.png",
      "body": ""
    }
  ],
  "images": [
    {
      "mimeType": "image/png",
      "fileName": "image-1.png",
      "bytes": 8
    }
  ],
  "metadata": {
    "prompt": "local cat"
  }
}
```

- Not run: live FAL API call.

AI-assisted change.

### 2026-07-12 follow-up: local image/video/music proof

- Exact PR head verified locally: `a0aa11dfcda60fc0408053651b37c81340512a88`.
- Command: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/fal/image-generation-provider.test.ts extensions/fal/video-generation-provider.test.ts extensions/fal/music-generation-provider.test.ts`.
- Result: passed 1 Vitest shard in 45.05s; 3 focused files passed; 68 tests passed.
- Coverage from the focused files: FAL image, video, and music provider paths using the shared `extensions/fal/http-config.ts` request-policy helper. This supplements the prior image-only controlled proof with local video/music coverage for the shared helper reach.
- This is controlled local provider-path proof only. No live FAL API call was made, and no real FAL account, proxy, private endpoint, or generated media artifact was exercised.

## Proof

### 2026-07-12 exact-head local provider tests after latest update-branch

- Exact head tested after normal `gh pr update-branch`: `e7fbb26d44c035ffece5896ed2903ae41ae4a3c2`.
- Scope: controlled local FAL image/video/music provider regression tests. This is not live FAL or representative external network proof.
- Commands run:

  ```bash
  git fetch fork alix/fal-request-policy-media-generation --no-tags
  git checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD
  git rev-parse HEAD
  git diff --check
  node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/fal/image-generation-provider.test.ts extensions/fal/video-generation-provider.test.ts extensions/fal/music-generation-provider.test.ts
  ```

- Result: PASS. `git diff --check` passed; Vitest passed 1 shard, 3 files, 68 tests in 230.37s total wall time. Vitest duration: 24.09s.
- Transcript excerpt:

  ```text
  HEAD is now at e7fbb26d44 Merge branch 'main' into alix/fal-request-policy-media-generation
  e7fbb26d44c035ffece5896ed2903ae41ae4a3c2
  Test Files  3 passed (3)
  Tests  68 passed (68)
  [test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 230.37s
  ```

- Observation: the focused tests cover the changed FAL image/video/music provider request-policy paths under local controlled conditions.
- Not tested / remaining review gap: no live FAL account, actual proxy/TLS route, or representative external private endpoint was exercised. This local proof should not be represented as the real-provider proof ClawSweeper requested.
